reviewed.note: HA dev 2026-11-01/02: room_temperature, room_humidity, room_window_open and room_condensation_risk (translation key condensation_risk) come from ViCare room controls, one device per room; not mapped (no unambiguous room or circuit for the card). condensation_risk is a candidate for the dew-point warning of #251. Holiday program and pellet sensors not used.

unmapped.heat: ViCare reports no live heat output, only consumption and production counters; the card estimates it from flow rate and spread.
unmapped.hc_return: ViCare has no return temperature per heating circuit; return_temperature belongs to the heat generator.
unmapped.room: Room temperatures come from ViCare room controls, one device per room without a translation key, so there is no unambiguous room per circuit.
